name: rate-limit

error.message: Number of request tokens has exceeded your per-minute rate limit.

reason: transient throttling — backing off and retrying is the correct response

name: overloaded
reason: explicit overload signal, Anthropic's own docs recommend backoff+retry here

name: api-error

error.message: An unexpected error has occurred internal to Anthropic's systems.

reason: generic upstream failure, transient by nature

name: authentication-error
reason: credentials are wrong; retrying sends the same bad key again

name: permission-error

error.message: Your API key does not have permission to use the specified resource.

reason: authorization problem, not a transient condition

name: invalid-request

error.message: messages: at least one message is required

reason: the request itself is malformed; retrying sends the same bad body again

name: request-too-large

error.message: Request exceeds the maximum allowed number of bytes.

reason: the payload itself is too big; retrying sends the same oversized request again
